Process: Legal obligations register and compliance risk assessment
Purpose: Keep a complete, current overview of the laws and regulatory requirements Trident must comply with in Norway, Chile and the UK, and assess the compliance risk in each (ISO 37301).
Trigger / inputs: New entity, market or activity; annual review; regulatory change from LEG-P02
Main activities: Map obligations by entity and area; assign an owner per obligation; assess likelihood and impact of non-compliance; agree controls with the owning department
Outputs: Legal obligations register; compliance risk assessment; owners per obligation
Interfaces: All departments (obligation owners); Technical & HSEQ (flag, class, Mattilsynet); Finance (tax)

Purpose: Detect new or changed laws and regulations in time and route them to the right owner before they take effect.
Trigger / inputs: Legislative and regulatory updates, industry associations, advisers
Main activities: Monitor sources; assess relevance and impact; assign owner and deadline; update the obligations register and affected processes
Outputs: Regulatory change log; actions with owner and deadline; updated obligations register
Interfaces: Technical & HSEQ; Finance; HR; Administration & ICT; Strategy & BD (CSRD)

Process: Contract management: templates, review and signing
Purpose: Ensure Trident's contracts protect value and limit risk, with consistent terms, proper review and correct authority to sign.
Trigger / inputs: Customer TC, yard, supplier or financing contract to be entered, renewed or amended
Main activities: Use standard templates and clauses; legal review by risk level; check authority matrix; sign and file in the contract register; track key dates
Outputs: Signed contracts; contract register with renewal and notice dates; approved deviations from standard terms
Interfaces: Commercial (TC contracts and terms); Vessel Operations (yards, suppliers); Finance (financing); Strategy & BD (newbuild contracts)

Purpose: Keep Trident's legal entity structure, board work and signing authorities in order across all jurisdictions.
Trigger / inputs: Board and general meetings; new or changed entity; change of management or authority
Main activities: Maintain entity overview; prepare and file board and shareholder minutes; maintain the authority matrix and signatory rights; corporate filings and registrations
Outputs: Entity register; board minutes; authority matrix; up-to-date registrations
Interfaces: CEO; Finance (tax structure, 3.4.6); Strategy & BD (M&A, new entities)

Process: Legal and compliance due diligence in acquisitions
Purpose: Identify legal and compliance risks before Trident acquires or partners with a company, and bring the target into Trident's compliance framework after closing.
Trigger / inputs: Approved M&A or partnership opportunity from SBD-P08
Main activities: Legal and compliance DD checklist; findings report; protections in the SPA (warranties, indemnities, conditions); 100-day compliance onboarding plan
Outputs: DD report; SPA protections; compliance onboarding plan for the acquired company
Interfaces: Strategy & BD (SBD-P08 M&A); Finance (financial DD); HR; Administration & ICT

Purpose: Prevent bribery, sanctions breaches and dealings with unsuitable counterparties (ISO 37001).
Trigger / inputs: New customer, supplier, agent or partner; new country; changes in sanctions lists
Main activities: Know-your-counterparty checks by risk level; sanctions screening; agent and intermediary approval; gifts and hospitality register; export control checks
Outputs: Approved counterparty list; screening records; gifts and hospitality register
Interfaces: Commercial (customers); Vessel Operations (suppliers, yards, agents); Finance (payments); Strategy & BD (targets)

Process: Code of conduct, whistleblowing and investigations
Purpose: Make Trident's ethical standards clear to everyone and ensure concerns can be raised safely and are handled properly.
Trigger / inputs: Onboarding; annual review; whistleblowing report; suspected misconduct
Main activities: Maintain the Code of Conduct; operate the whistleblowing channel; triage and investigate reports; decide and follow up on findings; report trends to the board
Outputs: Code of Conduct; whistleblowing log; investigation reports and actions

Purpose: Ensure personal data about employees, crew, customers and partners is processed lawfully and securely.
Trigger / inputs: New system or processing activity; data processor agreement; personal data breach
Main activities: Maintain the record of processing; data processor agreements; privacy impact assessments; handle data subject requests; breach notification within 72 hours
Outputs: Record of processing; data processor agreements; breach log

Purpose: Protect Trident's position in disputes and claims and recover insured losses efficiently.
Trigger / inputs: Incident, damage, contractual dispute or claim against or by Trident
Main activities: Register the claim; preserve evidence; notify insurers (P&I, H&M); manage advisers and negotiation; settle or litigate; record lessons learned
Outputs: Claims and disputes register; insurance recoveries; lessons learned to the owning process
Interfaces: Finance (insurance, provisions); Technical & HSEQ (incidents); Vessel Operations; Commercial (customer disputes)

Process: Compliance training, certification and board reporting
Purpose: Ensure employees know the rules that apply to them and that the board has a clear view of Trident's compliance status.
Trigger / inputs: Annual compliance plan; onboarding; board calendar
Main activities: Annual risk-based training plan; e-learning and workshops; annual compliance declarations; compliance KPIs; annual compliance report to the board
Outputs: Training records; signed declarations; annual compliance report
Interfaces: HR (onboarding, training records); all departments; board
